notes:
What's new in Vekrun 0.4.5 — Local models in one click

• Download any local model with one click. If this Mac doesn't have Ollama yet, Vekrun installs it (Ollama's official build, checked against its published checksum, or the Ollama app through Homebrew), starts it, connects it, and then downloads the model — all from that one Download.
• Every step shows on the model's card with its elapsed time and what comes next, and it keeps showing if you leave the page and come back. You can stop the engine install; nothing downloads after a stop. If a step fails, the card says which one and why.
• The download dialog counts the space Ollama itself needs and won't start a download that doesn't fit on the disk.
• On a Mac where /Applications needs an administrator, Vekrun installs Ollama into your home folder straight away — no admin rights needed.
• Fixed: a leftover ~/.ollama folder (after Ollama was removed) was taken for an install, so Vekrun tried to start an Ollama that wasn't there.
• LM Studio is hidden for now while we finish testing it.
